title: Ek musaafir qaid hai beemaar hai
body:
Ek musaafir qaid hai beemaar hai
kaarwaane sabr ka saalaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tegh syed ke gale par chal gayi, chaadare binte ali bhi jal gayi
Aur phir shaame ghareeba'n dhal gayi, ab kahan abbas pehredaar hai
kaarwaane sabr ka saalaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gulshane qaatoone jannat ki kali, kaarzaare shaam me paidal chali
kis tarah mu ko chupae binte ali, kab mayassar saayae deewaar hai
kaarwaane sabr ka saalaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
raaste hai shaam ke kaanto bhare, aable hai paao me kaise chale
zaqm taaza hai mere sajjad ke, jeena ab beemaar ka dushwaar hai
kaarwaane sabr ka saalaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke ghame sakina mar gayi, khaake zaalim ke tamaache dil jali
qaid me karte hai sab nouha gari, sog me dooba hua ghamqaar hai
kaarwaane sabr ka saalaar hai
